I am 48 and this is my yearly skin reset. My morning skincare routine after my CO2 skin resurfacing consists of gentle cleansing, hypochlorous acid, Hyaluronic acid serum, with eye and face sunscreen. CO2 skin resurfacing is great for skin rejuvenation, lightening hyperpigmentation, improving skin quality and texture. I try to do 1-2 laser treatments a year. This treatment has 5 days of downtime but it’s so worth it!
